items.project: Aldar Dubai villa community (with Dubai Holding)
items.title: Aldar plans a large Dubai villa and townhouse launch before year-end
items.summary: Aldar's fourth Dubai project, in partnership with Dubai Holding, will offer villas and townhouses and is due to launch by end-2026; name, size and prices not yet disclosed.

items.title: Al Tay Hills opens show villas for its 1,100-home Sharjah community
items.summary: Dh3.5bn community of about 1,100 townhouses, twin and standalone villas and mansions (mostly 3–6 BR); show villas are now complete for buyers to view.

items.title: New developer ORAYA announces its first project on Marjan Beach
items.summary: A fully furnished, hospitality-branded residential project in Ras Al Khaimah; unit mix, prices and handover to be announced in the coming weeks.
